content.text: {"id": "mm6744a7", "data_focus": {"v": "limited", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In January 2018, the Indiana State Department of Health (ISDH) was notified of a case of Cronobacter sakazakii meningitis"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "This case demonstrates the potential for invasive infection with this emerging pathogen"}]}, "outcome_types": [], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "C. sakazakii was isolated from expressed breast milk samples, the breast pump kit,"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case report/series", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This case demonstrates the potential for invasive infection with this emerging pathogen"}]}, {"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ISDH, in partnership with clinicians from the hospital and CDC, conducted an investigation to identify the source of infection."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Pulsed field gel electrophoresis (PFGE) was performed on all C. sakazakii isolates using the PulseNet Cronobacter protocol"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Environmental isolates were indistinguishable or differed by one band by PFGE from the clinical isolate."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
